mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion across labor and manufacturing sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and INDPRO rise month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 6.0%), a month-over-month decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.2pp during high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong manufacturing and construction sectors, indicating broad economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST rise month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 100), a month-over-month rebound in INDPRO (MoM) signals a manufacturing recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises > 0.5% MoM during low production (INDPRO < 100), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
